canonicalization.name: JSON_SORT_KEYS_COMPACT_ASCII_V1
procedure: Construct the preimage object using only the allowlisted fields below.
Serialize as JSON with keys sorted recursively.
Use separators ',' and ':' with no insignificant whitespace.
Encode non-ASCII characters using JSON escapes (ensure_ascii=true).
Encode the serialized JSON as ASCII bytes.
Compute SHA-256 over those ASCII bytes.

preimage_projection.rule: Fields not listed in the applicable allowlist are excluded from the hash preimage, even if they are present in the published checkpoint document.

published_after_hash.reason: These fields are derived from, describe, or self-reference the checkpoint produced by hashing the preimage and therefore cannot be members of that preimage.

verification_algorithm: Fetch the checkpoint document for sequence N.
Project the checkpoint into the allowlisted preimage shape defined above.
Canonicalize the projected object using JSON_SORT_KEYS_COMPACT_ASCII_V1.
Compute SHA-256 of the canonical ASCII bytes.
Require the digest to equal checkpoint.tip and the current status tip when N is the current sequence.
immutability_note: This specification documents the derivation rule for already-published checkpoints. It does not modify or rewrite checkpoint 2 or any prior chain state.
